main.summary: Provides a non-seekable read-only view of a stream with a known content length.

field.name: inner
field.summary: Underlying stream that supplies the content.

field.name: length
field.summary: Known content length exposed by this wrapper.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying stream can be read.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether seeking is supported.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether writing is supported.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets or sets the stream position.
property.exception: The stream does not support positioning.

method.name: Read
method.summary: Reads bytes from the underlying stream.
method.param: Maximum number of bytes to read.

method.name: ReadAsyncMemory
method.summary: Asynchronously reads bytes from the underlying stream.

method.name: ReadAsyncArray
method.summary: Asynchronously reads bytes from the underlying stream.
method.param: Maximum number of bytes to read.

method.name: Seek
method.exception: The stream does not support seeking.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Releases the underlying stream when disposing synchronously.
method.param: Whether managed resources should be released.
